application.description: Google Drive API v3 - Manage files and folders in Google Drive. Upload, download, search, share, and organize your cloud storage programmatically.

services.description: Lists or searches files and folders in Google Drive

q.description: Query string for searching files. Examples: 'name contains "hello"', 'mimeType = "application/vnd.google-apps.folder"', 'modifiedTime > "2023-01-01T00:00:00"'

orderBy.description: Sort order for results. Examples: 'folder,modifiedTime desc', 'name', 'createdTime'

fields.default: nextPageToken, files(id, name, mimeType, size, modifiedTime, parents, webViewLink, webContentLink)

changelog.1.0.0: Initial version with complete file management operations including list, get, create, update, delete, copy, move, download, export, permissions management, folder operations, storage quota, and trash management
changelog.2.0.0: MAJOR UPDATE: Added comprehensive parameter lookup functionality for dynamic folder and file selection. All folder-related parameters (parents, addParents, removeParents, newParentId, oldParentId) and file-related parameters (fileId across all services) now support dropdown selection with real-time data from Google Drive API. This eliminates manual ID entry and significantly improves user experience.
changelog.2.0.4: Fixed create_file service to use full upload URL in endpoint_template, removing dependency on hardcoded upload URL logic in service executor
changelog.2.0.5: Changed parameter_method to 'multipart_related' for Google Drive uploads to specify the multipart encoding type, removing all hardcoded checks from service executor
changelog.2.0.6: Fixed sample_payload fields in events to be proper JSON objects instead of strings, resolving API validation errors
